title: Lean Manager – Warehouse Operations (f/m/d)
description:
Drive improvement projects in our two Hamburg warehouses.

What you'll do
- Map warehouse processes and measure cycle times
- Lead Lean workshops with shift leaders
- Implement layout and flow changes and track KPIs

What you bring
- 3+ years in Lean, continuous improvement or industrial engineering
- Experience in warehouse or logistics operations
- Strong analytical skills (Excel, SQL)
- Good English
